title: Can I MASTER FPS Chess?
summary: The creator returns to FPS Chess (a game where 'bullet is not a time control'): a chess game against online players in public servers where every capture attempt becomes a real-time first-person-shooter duel between the two pieces in a 3D arena, with a 3-2-1 countdown; the winner of the duel takes/keeps the square. Each piece type has its own weapon/abilities (e.g. king is a strong melee fighter, pawn shoots, knight has a bow with arrows and can sprint with Left Shift, bishops can fly, E is an ability key, shots can be blocked). He uses the 'bongcloud' king-walk strategy since the king is the strongest fighter, wins game 1 king vs king, loses game 2 to a pawn sniping him, and continues with mixed results; pieces carry damage/health between fights.
rules: Standard chess movement on the board, turn-based, vs online human opponents.
When a piece attempts to capture, the two pieces fight a real-time FPS duel (3-2-1 countdown) in an arena; the winner survives (attacker takes the square if it wins, defender survives otherwise).

Each piece class has different weapons/abilities and health: king = strongest fighter (melee 'single swipe'), pawn = gun, knight = bow + sprint (Left Shift), bishop can fly; E activates an ability; you can block shots.
Win by winning the duel against the enemy king (capturing the king).
win_condition: Capture the enemy king by winning the duel.
